C.sentence: The passages do not test whether normal RUNX1 expression promotes tumors; they show RUNX1 acting as a tumor suppressor in T-ALL [8] and in myelodysplasia/leukemia of Fanconi anemia, where RUNX1 lesions occur [5].
LDL cholesterol is described as causally involved in cardiovascular disease, as stated directly in passage 9 ("LDL cholesterol has a causal role in the development of cardiovascular disease") [9].
A meta-analysis of perinatal factors reported higher odds of breast cancer for birth weight of 4,000 g or more (OR 1.24) and a pooled relative risk of 1.15 per category increase [4][9].
Some mental health gains tracked with weight loss, though the evidence on whether preoperative conditions predict weight outcomes is inconsistent [8][10].
The study population was patients with intracerebral hemorrhage, a form of stroke, so the finding applies to that stroke subtype only [1].

Passage [7] states that the centers of human tuberculosis granulomas have a pro-inflammatory environment characterized by antimicrobial peptides, reactive oxygen species, and pro-inflammatory eicosanoids [7].
The passages do not directly test whether normal RUNX1 expression promotes tumors; most describe RUNX1 as a tumor suppressor or describe RUNX1 loss or mutation in disease [6][9][5].

Passage [7] shows that Lrh-1, the protein encoded by NR5A2, is expressed in the mouse and human endometrium and that reducing NR5A2 transcript abundance in human endometrial stromal cells abrogated decidualization, a key endometrial developmental process.
This establishes that HAM/TSP patients' IgG cross-reacts with Tax through hnRNP-A1 mimicry [4].

The only lung-fibrosis passage reports the opposite direction: AMPK activity is lower in fibrotic lung regions, and metformin, an AMPK activator, reverses established fibrosis in an AMPK-dependent manner [8].

The claim that cell-autonomous sex determination does not occur in Galliformes is contradicted by the chicken gynandromorph and chimera study, which shows that avian somatic cells carry an inherent sex identity and that sexual differentiation is substantially cell autonomous [6].

The passages describe PCP signalling polarizing neural progenitors and Vangl2 (trilobite) being required for neural keel polarization during zebrafish neurulation [10], and Wnt5a regulating subcellular distribution of Vangl2 in mice [6].
Passage [3] states that CTCF anchor regions are a frequent site of mutations in cancer cells, but it does not mention recurrent mutations or oncogenes adjacent to these sites [3].
